items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 6 at 2:26AM PDT until October 6 at 9:00AM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...San Francisco, Coastal North Bay Including Point Reyes
National Seashore, San Francisco Peninsula Coast, Northern Monterey
Bay, and Southern Monterey Bay.

* WHEN...Until 9 AM PDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.
items.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.

If commuting, allow extra drive time to reach your destination
safely.
